format: Perl (with embedded assembly for ARMv8 NEON/ARM64)
description: This file contains implementation of AES encryption/decryption routines optimized for ARMv8 NEON, including key schedule, CBC, ECB, and CTR modes, with external references to OpenSSL and BoringSSL components.

methods.name: _aes_preheat
methods.description: Prepares constants and NEON registers for AES operations.

methods.name: _aes_encrypt_core
methods.description: Performs AES encryption on input data using NEON instructions.

methods.name: _aes_decrypt_preheat
methods.description: Prepares constants and NEON registers for AES decryption.

methods.name: _aes_decrypt_core
methods.description: Performs AES decryption on input data using NEON instructions.

methods.name: _aes_schedule_core
methods.description: Generates AES key schedule for encryption/decryption.

methods.name: _aes_schedule_transform
methods.description: Transforms key schedule according to AES round transformations.

methods.name: _aes_schedule_mangle
methods.description: Mangles the last round key for encryption or de-mangles for decryption.

methods.name: vpaes_set_encrypt_key
methods.description: Sets up the AES encryption key schedule.

methods.name: vpaes_set_decrypt_key
methods.description: Sets up the AES decryption key schedule.

methods.name: vpaes_ctr32_encrypt_blocks
methods.description: Performs AES CTR mode encryption on multiple blocks.
